name: @hiranoa/picomatch
description: picomatch 4.0.7 with conservative repeated-extglob protection for GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf

hiranoaPatch.change: Classify unbounded repeated-extglob bodies as risky, including single branches, explicit recursion opt-outs and escaped regex syntax emitted by unescape=true. Reuse upstream literal fallback and safe character-class flattening.
hiranoaPatch.compatibility: Complex repetitions containing wildcards, regex quantifiers, escaped classes, nested groups or braces become literal patterns unless the existing safe character flattening applies. Repeated alternatives must be distinct, equal-length plain literals; insensitive alternatives are restricted to ASCII. Ordinary globs and supported fixed-width repetitions are preserved.
hiranoaPatch.scope: Mitigates repeated-extglob ambiguity in GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf. Upstream native-regex compatibility syntax such as (a+)+ is unchanged and is not safe for arbitrary untrusted patterns. Hiranoa uses these development tools with project-controlled patterns, not Markdown input.
hiranoaPatch.removal: Replace with an official patched release after the regression suite passes.
